title: Kling AI Releases Kling 4.0 With Expanded Public API Access and 30 Second Video Clips
summary:
The company behind the Kling generative AI system has integrated its latest multimodal tool into the fal, Runway, and Higgsfield platforms. The software, which recently entered its general API rollout phase, is now accessible to all customers on the fal platform, allowing developers to embed the video generation model into their own product workflows.

The new system supports the creation of native video scenes up to 30 seconds long and includes a tool that combines as many as 15 different image, video, or voice assets in a single generation. To improve scene progression, creators can use up to 10 keyframes, while a partnership with Runway provides new Max and Team plan users with 3 days of unlimited access to the model.
